paragraphs: Many children in Ireland go to school by bus. The Government wants families to pay more for the school bus.
From next September, a secondary school pupil will pay €350 a year. Now they pay €100. The price was cut in 2022 to help families.

Cathal Crowe leads a group of TDs that looks at education. He says the rise is too much for families. He thinks the Government should look at it again. The Taoiseach said some price rises might change.
The bus is expensive for the State. It costs €1,400 to €1,500 a year for each child. Next year the service will cost €687 million.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭有很多孩子搭公車上學。
政府希望家庭為校車付更多錢。
從明年九月起，中學生每年要付350歐元。
現在他們付100歐元。
票價在2022年被調降，以幫助家庭。
卡哈爾・克羅領導一個負責教育議題的國會議員小組。
他說這次漲價對家庭來說太多了。
他認為政府應該重新考慮。
總理說有些漲價可能會改變。
校車對國家來說很昂貴。
每個孩子每年要花1,400到1,500歐元。
明年這項服務將花費6億8,700萬歐元。

paragraphs: The head of the Oireachtas Education Committee says the Government's plan to raise school bus fares will have to be looked at again. Fianna Fáil TD Cathal Crowe said it was unrealistic to put this extra cost on families at a time when living costs are rising again.

Fares were cut in 2022 to help families with the cost of living. But in October's budget, the Government decided to bring them back to their old level from next September. For secondary school pupils, the yearly fare will rise from €100 to €350.

Some Independent TDs and ministers have spoken out against the plan. On Wednesday, the Taoiseach, Micheál Martin, said some of the increases might be reviewed, although the Tánaiste, Simon Harris, had earlier said the decision would not be reversed.

Officials from the Department of Education told the committee that it costs between €1,400 and €1,500 a year to bring one child to school by bus. The cost of the scheme has gone up by 58% since 2020 and is expected to reach €687 million next year, including €143 million for taxis for children with special needs.
sentZh: 國會教育委員會主席表示，政府調漲校車票價的計畫必須重新檢視。
共和黨議員卡哈爾・克羅說，在生活費再度上漲的時候，把這筆額外費用加在家庭身上是不切實際的。
票價在2022年被調降，以幫助家庭應付生活費。
但在十月的預算案中，政府決定從明年九月起將票價恢復到原來的水準。
中學生的每年票價將從100歐元漲到350歐元。
一些無黨籍議員和部長已公開反對這項計畫。
總理米霍爾・馬丁星期三表示，部分漲幅可能會重新檢討，不過副總理賽門・哈里斯先前曾說這項決定不會撤回。
教育部官員告訴委員會，用校車載一個孩子上學每年要花1,400到1,500歐元。
這項計畫的成本自2020年以來上漲了58%，預計明年將達到6億8,700萬歐元，其中包括為特殊需求兒童支付的1億4,300萬歐元計程車費用。

paragraphs: The chair of the Oireachtas Education Committee has said the Government's decision to increase school transport fares will have to be revisited. Fianna Fáil TD Cathal Crowe described the move as an unrealistic burden on families who are already struggling with renewed cost-of-living pressures.

Fares were reduced in 2022 as a cost-of-living measure, but in October's budget the Government announced that they would return to their previous levels from next September. As a result, the annual fare for post-primary pupils will rise from €100 to €350 for the 2027/2028 school year.

The plan has met opposition from Independent TDs and ministers who support the Government. On Wednesday, Taoiseach Micheál Martin signalled that some of the increases could be reviewed, even though Tánaiste Simon Harris had ruled out a reversal the previous week.

Department of Education officials told the committee that carrying one child on a school bus costs between €1,400 and €1,500 a year, with the State covering 93% of the cost at primary level and 75% at post-primary level. The scheme's cost has risen by 58% since 2020 and is projected to reach €687 million next year, of which €143 million goes on taxis for children with special needs.

paragraphs: The chair of the Oireachtas Education Committee has warned that the Government's decision to hike school transport fares will have to be revisited. Fianna Fáil TD Cathal Crowe branded it an unrealistic burden to heap on families already grappling with a resurgence in cost-of-living pressures.

Fares were slashed in 2022 as a temporary relief measure, but October's budget stipulated that they would revert to their former levels from next September. Consequently, the annual charge for post-primary pupils is set to soar from €100 to €350 in the 2027/2028 academic year.

The proposal has drawn fierce resistance from Independent TDs and the ministers who prop up the coalition. On Wednesday, Taoiseach Micheál Martin intimated that certain increases might be reconsidered, despite Tánaiste Simon Harris having categorically ruled out a U-turn only a week earlier.

Officials from the Department of Education informed the committee that conveying a single child by school bus costs between €1,400 and €1,500 annually, with the State subsidising 93% of the outlay at primary level and 75% at post-primary level. Expenditure on the scheme has ballooned by 58% since 2020 and is forecast to reach €687 million next year, €143 million of which is earmarked for taxis for children with special needs.
